summary: Implemented TemplateService with full template discovery, validation, caching, and parameter resolution. Created IDocumentTemplate interface and related types, a JSON Schema for template validation, a validator module with structural/semantic checks, a parameterizer module that substitutes placeholders and validates against constraints, and sample templates for all three categories (invoice, pdf-conversion, contract-summarization). The service is exported as a singleton from src/services/index.ts.
